name: Power
author: eztvn
description: Always-on battery percentage and live watt readout in the bar, opening a popup with the consumption graph, usage stats, power profile, system performance and battery health.

barWidget.description: Battery percentage plus live watts, with a popup for consumption graph, stats, power profile and system performance.

schema.label: AC sampling interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often battery draw is sampled while on AC power.

schema.label: Battery sampling interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often battery draw is sampled on battery with the balanced power profile.

schema.label: Power-saver sampling interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often battery draw is sampled on battery with the power-saver profile.

schema.label: Performance sampling interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often battery draw is sampled on battery with the performance profile.

schema.label: Graph window (minutes)
schema.description: Time span rendered in the consumption graph.

schema.label: Power profile refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the active power profile is re-read to adjust the sampling cadence.

schema.label: Panel refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often battery and system details refresh while the popup is open.
